description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Crookshank Kobolds token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Crookshank Kobolds, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
